Java — interactive course Java 21 LTS

Interactive course

Java, from fundamentals to the runtime and the database

Self-contained modules, each a single offline HTML file. One running example — a warehouse's products, orders and inventory — grows with you from the first int through a concurrent pricing pipeline to a real database. Every program shown was compiled and executed against a real JDK when the page was built; the output you read is the output it printed.

  1. 1Java FundamentalsHow Java actually runs your code — types, objects, collections and exceptions — built around one order-and-inventory system you carry from the first example to the last.BasicJava 21 LTS6–8 hours23 sections
  2. 2Java IntermediateThe modern language and library — generics in depth, lambdas and streams, records, sealed types and pattern matching, Optional, java.time and NIO — applied to the same order-and-inventory system, now grown into a pricing and reporting pipeline.IntermediateJava 21 LTS9–11 hours22 sections
  3. 3Java AdvancedThe runtime — threads and the memory model, locks and concurrent collections, executors, CompletableFuture and virtual threads, garbage collection, class loading, reflection, modules and performance measurement — as the warehouse becomes a concurrent reservation service that must stay correct and responsive under load.AdvancedJava 21 LTS10–12 hours23 sections
  4. 4JPA & HibernatePersistence done properly — entity mapping, the persistence context, relationships and fetching, JPQL and the Criteria API, transactions and locking, inheritance, batching and caching, schema management — with the warehouse's products, orders and stock finally stored in a real database, and every SQL statement on the page emitted by Hibernate itself at build time.AppliedJava 21 · Hibernate 7.4 · JPA 3.2 · H29–11 hours21 sections
  5. 5Spring Data JPAThe same warehouse, now a Spring Boot application — repositories, derived and declared queries, transactions as a cross-cutting concern, projections, auditing, pagination, validation and testing — with every statement on the page emitted by Spring Boot 4.1 and Hibernate 7.4 at build time.AppliedJava 21 · Spring Boot 4.1 · Spring Data JPA · Hibernate 7.4 · H28–10 hours16 sections

How the modules fit together

Each module ends with a scored quiz tuned to its learning objectives. Score 85% or more and the next module assumes everything the quiz covered; below 65% and the sections you missed are worth a second pass first. Progress, notes and quiz answers are saved per module in this browser, and nothing is ever sent anywhere.

Works offline; makes no network requests. Press t to switch theme.
